name: bocha-search
description: 博查是一个给AI用的中文搜索引擎，让你的AI应用从近百亿网页和生态内容源中获取高质量的世界知识，涵盖天气、新闻、百科、医疗、火车票、图片等多种领域。
descriptionEn: Bocha is a Chinese search engine for AI, you can get enhanced search details from billions of web documents, including weather, news, wikis, healthcare, train tickets, images, and more.
